#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+    }
+

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    errno = 0;

+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+        return false;
+    }
+

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;

+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+        return false;
+    }
+

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization.  This is kept

+constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const std::size_t N,
+                                    const std::size_t i,
+                                    const std::size_t j) noexcept {

+void initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                    const std::size_t N,
+                    const std::size_t firstRow,
+                    const std::size_t rowCount) {
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (std::int64_t localRow = 0;
+         localRow < static_cast<std::int64_t>(rowCount);
+         ++localRow) {
+        const std::size_t globalRow =
+            firstRow + static_cast<std::size_t>(localRow);

+bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+        return false;
+    }
+

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+                    const std::size_t N,
+                    const std::size_t firstRow,

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+                    const std::size_t firstRow,

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+void initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                    const std::size_t N,
+                    const std::size_t firstRow,
+                    const std::size_t rowCount) {

-constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {
-    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kTileSize = 32;
+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

    32	    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
    33	
    34	    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
    35	    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
    36	    const std::size_t rowBase =
    37	        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
    38	        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
    39	    const std::size_t col =
    40	        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
    41	        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
    42	
    43	    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    44	
    45	    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
    46	        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
    47	        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
    48	        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
    49	        const unsigned int linearThread =
    50	            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    51	        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
    52	             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
    53	             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
    54	            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
    55	            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
    56	            const std::size_t aRow =
    57	                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
    58	            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
    59	            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
    60	            const std::size_t bCol =
    61	                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
    62	
    63	            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
    64	                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
    65	            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
    66	                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
    67	        }
    68	        __syncthreads();
    69	
    70	        #pragma unroll
    71	        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
    72	            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
    73	            #pragma unroll
    74	            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
    75	                accumulators[outputRow] +=
    76	                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
    77	            }
    78	        }
    79	        __syncthreads();
    80	    }
    81	
    82	    #pragma unroll
    83	    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
    84	        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
    85	        if (row < rows && col < N) {
    86	            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
    87	        }
    88	    }
    89	}
    90	
    91	[[noreturn]] void abortMPI(const int rank, const char* message) {
    92	    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: %s\n", rank, message);
    93	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
    94	    std::abort();
    95	}
    96	
    97	void checkCuda(const cudaError_t status, const int rank, const char* operation) {
    98	    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
    99	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n",
   100	                     rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
   101	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   102	        std::abort();
   103	    }
   104	}
   105	
   106	// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization.  This is kept
   107	// identical to the original benchmark so that -r remains reproducible.
   108	constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const std::size_t N,
   109	                                    const std::size_t i,
   110	                                    const std::size_t j) noexcept {
   111	    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) /
   112	           static_cast<double>(N * N);
   113	}
   114	
   115	void initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& matrix,
   116	                    const std::size_t N,
   117	                    const std::size_t firstRow,
   118	                    const std::size_t rowCount) {
   119	    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   120	    for (std::int64_t localRow = 0;
   121	         localRow < static_cast<std::int64_t>(rowCount);
   122	         ++localRow) {
   123	        const std::size_t globalRow =
   124	            firstRow + static_cast<std::size_t>(localRow);
   125	        for (std::size_t column = 0; column < N; ++column) {
   126	            matrix[static_cast<std::size_t>(localRow) * N + column] =
   127	                getPseudoRndValue(N, globalRow, column);
   128	        }
   129	    }
   130	}
   131	
   132	bool parseMatrixSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
   133	    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
   134	        return false;
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    errno = 0;
   138	    char* end = nullptr;
   139	    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
   140	    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
   141	        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
   142	        return false;
   143	    }
   144	    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
   145	    return true;
   146	}
   147	
   148	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
   149	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
   150	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   151	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\n");
   152	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   153	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   154	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   155	}
   156	
   157	bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& A,
   158	                    const std::vector<double>& B,
   159	                    const std::vector<double>& C,
   160	                    const std::size_t N) {
   161	    constexpr std::size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};
   162	
   163	    for (std::size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {
   164	        for (std::size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {
   165	            const std::size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;
   166	            const std::size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;
   167	
   168	            double expected = 0.0;
   169	            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
   170	                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];
   171	            }
   172	
   173	            const double actual = C[i * N + j];
   174	            const double relativeError =
   175	                std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));
   176	
   177	            if (relativeError > 1e-6) {
   178	                std::printf(
   179	                    "Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f "
   180	                    "(error: %.10e)\n",
   181	                    i, j, expected, actual, relativeError);
   182	                return false;
   183	            }
   184	        }
   185	    }
   186	    return true;
   187	}
   188	
   189	}  // namespace
   190	
   191	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   192	    int providedThreadLevel = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   193	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &providedThreadLevel);
   194	
   195	    int rank = 0;
   196	    int worldSize = 1;
   197	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   198	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);
   199	    if (providedThreadLevel < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   200	        abortMPI(rank, "MPI implementation does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED");
   201	    }
   202	
   203	    std::size_t N = 512;
   204	    bool validate = false;
   205	    bool printResults = false;
   206	    bool showHelp = false;
   207	    bool argumentsValid = true;
   208	
   209	    for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
   210	        if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-n") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   211	            argumentsValid =
   212	                parseMatrixSize(argv[++argument], N) && argumentsValid;
   213	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
   214	            validate = true;
   215	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
   216	            printResults = true;
   217	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
   218	            showHelp = true;
   219	        } else {
   220	            argumentsValid = false;
   221	        }
   222	    }
   223	
   224	    if (!argumentsValid || showHelp) {
   225	        if (rank == 0) {
   226	            if (!argumentsValid) {
   227	                std::printf("Invalid command line arguments.\n");
   228	            }
   229	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   230	        }
   231	        MPI_Finalize();
   232	        return argumentsValid ? 0 : 1;
   233	    }
   234	
   235	    if (N > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / N) {
   236	        abortMPI(rank, "matrix size overflows the host address space");
   237	    }
   238	    const std::size_t matrixElements = N * N;
   239	    if (matrixElements > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() /
   240	                             sizeof(double)) {
   241	        abortMPI(rank, "matrix allocation size overflows the host address space");
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    if (rank == 0) {
   245	        std::printf("Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\n");
   246	        std::printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", N, N);
   247	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    MPI_Comm localCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   251	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
   252	                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &localCommunicator);
   253	    int localRank = 0;
   254	    MPI_Comm_rank(localCommunicator, &localRank);
   255	
   256	    int deviceCount = 0;
   257	    checkCuda(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount), rank, "cudaGetDeviceCount");
   258	    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
   259	        abortMPI(rank, "no CUDA devices are visible to this MPI rank");
   260	    }
   261	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   262	    checkCuda(cudaSetDevice(device), rank, "cudaSetDevice");
   263	
   264	    const std::size_t rankAsSize = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
   265	    const std::size_t worldAsSize = static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize);
   266	    const std::size_t baseRows = N / worldAsSize;
   267	    const std::size_t extraRows = N % worldAsSize;
   268	    const std::size_t localRows = baseRows + (rankAsSize < extraRows ? 1 : 0);
   269	    const std::size_t firstRow =
   270	        rankAsSize * baseRows + std::min(rankAsSize, extraRows);
   271	    const std::size_t localElements = localRows * N;
   272	
   273	    std::vector<double> localA(localElements);
   274	    std::vector<double> B(matrixElements);
   275	    std::vector<double> localC(localElements);
   276	
   277	    if (rank == 0) {
   278	        std::printf("Initializing matrices...\n");
   279	    }
   280	    initMatrixRows(localA, N, firstRow, localRows);
   281	    initMatrixRows(B, N, 0, N);
   282	
   283	    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   284	    double* deviceA = nullptr;
   285	    double* deviceB = nullptr;
   286	    double* deviceC = nullptr;
   287	    checkCuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking),
   288	              rank, "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
   289	    const std::size_t localBytes =
   290	        std::max<std::size_t>(1, localElements) * sizeof(double);
   291	    const std::size_t matrixBytes = matrixElements * sizeof(double);
   292	    checkCuda(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceA), localBytes),
   293	              rank, "cudaMalloc(A)");
   294	    checkCuda(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceB), matrixBytes),
   295	              rank, "cudaMalloc(B)");
   296	    checkCuda(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceC), localBytes),
   297	              rank, "cudaMalloc(C)");
   298	
   299	    if (localElements != 0) {
   300	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceA, localA.data(), localBytes,
   301	                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
   302	                  rank, "cudaMemcpyAsync(A)");
   303	    }
   304	    checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceB, B.data(), matrixBytes,
   305	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
   306	              rank, "cudaMemcpyAsync(B)");
   307	    checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank, "initial H2D copies");
   308	
   309	    if (rank == 0) {
   310	        std::printf("Computing matrix multiplication...\n");
   311	    }
   312	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   313	    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
   314	
   315	    if (localRows != 0) {
   316	        const dim3 block(kTileSize / 1, kTileSize / kRowsPerThread, 1);
   317	        const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((N + kTileSize - 1) /
   318	                                                   kTileSize),
   319	                        static_cast<unsigned int>((localRows + kTileSize - 1) /
   320	                                                   kTileSize),
   321	                        1);
   322	        matrixMultiplyKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   323	            deviceA, deviceB, deviceC, localRows, N);
   324	        checkCuda(cudaGetLastError(), rank, "matrixMultiplyKernel launch");
   325	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(localC.data(), deviceC, localBytes,
   326	                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
   327	                  rank, "cudaMemcpyAsync(C)");
   328	    }
   329	    checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank, "matrix multiplication");
   330	    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
   331	    const double localSeconds =
   332	        std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();
   333	
   334	    checkCuda(cudaFree(deviceA), rank, "cudaFree(A)");
   335	    checkCuda(cudaFree(deviceB), rank, "cudaFree(B)");
   336	    checkCuda(cudaFree(deviceC), rank, "cudaFree(C)");
   337	    checkCuda(cudaStreamDestroy(stream), rank, "cudaStreamDestroy");
   338	    MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator);
   339	
   340	    double maximumSeconds = 0.0;
   341	    MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &maximumSeconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   342	               MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   343	
   344	    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
   345	    std::vector<int> displacements;
   346	    std::vector<double> globalC;
   347	    std::vector<double> globalA;
   348	    if (validate || printResults) {
   349	        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
   350	        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
   351	        std::size_t displacement = 0;
   352	        for (int receiver = 0; receiver < worldSize; ++receiver) {
   353	            const std::size_t receiverRows =
   354	                baseRows + (static_cast<std::size_t>(receiver) < extraRows ? 1 : 0);
   355	            const std::size_t receiverElements = receiverRows * N;
   356	            if (receiverElements > static_cast<std::size_t>(
   357	                                      std::numeric_limits<int>::max()) ||
   358	                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(
   359	                                   std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
   360	                abortMPI(rank,
   361	                         "-v/-r matrix is too large for MPI_Gatherv counts");
   362	            }
   363	            receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(receiver)] =
   364	                static_cast<int>(receiverElements);
   365	            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(receiver)] =
   366	                static_cast<int>(displacement);
   367	            displacement += receiverElements;
   368	        }
   369	        if (rank == 0) {
   370	            globalC.resize(matrixElements);
   371	            if (validate) {
   372	                globalA.resize(matrixElements);
   373	            }
   374	        }
   375	
   376	        MPI_Gatherv(localC.data(), static_cast<int>(localElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
   377	                    rank == 0 ? globalC.data() : nullptr,
   378	                    receiveCounts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
   379	                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   380	        if (validate) {
   381	            MPI_Gatherv(localA.data(), static_cast<int>(localElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
   382	                        rank == 0 ? globalA.data() : nullptr,
   383	                        receiveCounts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
   384	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   385	        }
   386	    }
   387	
   388	    if (rank == 0) {
   389	        const double gflops =
   390	            maximumSeconds > 0.0
   391	                ? (2.0 * static_cast<double>(N) * static_cast<double>(N) *
   392	                   static_cast<double>(N)) /
   393	                      maximumSeconds / 1e9
   394	                : 0.0;
   395	        const long durationMilliseconds =
   396	            static_cast<long>(maximumSeconds * 1000.0);
   397	        std::printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", durationMilliseconds);
   398	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
   399	
   400	        if (printResults) {
   401	            print_results(globalC, "MatrixC");
   402	        }
   403	    }
   404	
   405	    int validationPassed = 1;
   406	    if (validate) {
   407	        if (rank == 0) {
   408	            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   409	            validationPassed = validateResult(globalA, B, globalC, N) ? 1 : 0;
   410	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n",
   411	                        validationPassed == 1 ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   412	        }
   413	        MPI_Bcast(&validationPassed, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   414	    }
   415	
   416	    MPI_Finalize();
   417	    return validationPassed == 1 ? 0 : 1;
   418	}

+constexpr int kRowsPerThread = 4;
+
+// The row decomposition keeps A and C local to an MPI rank.  B is replicated
+// once per rank so that each GPU can execute its local rows without a per-tile
+// MPI synchronization.
+__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ B,
+                                     double* __restrict__ C,
+                                     const std::size_t rows,
+                                     const std::size_t N) {
+    __shared__ double tileA[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+    __shared__ double tileB[kTileSize][kTileSize];
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const std::size_t rowBase =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(ty * kRowsPerThread);
+    const std::size_t col =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(tx);
+
+    double accumulators[kRowsPerThread] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
+
+    for (std::size_t tileStart = 0; tileStart < N; tileStart += kTileSize) {
+        // There are 256 threads and 1024 values in each shared tile.  Each
+        // thread loads four values, giving coalesced global accesses for both
+        // matrices while keeping the tile size large enough for reuse.
+        const unsigned int linearThread =
+            threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+        for (unsigned int index = linearThread;
+             index < kTileSize * kTileSize;
+             index += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {
+            const int tileRow = static_cast<int>(index / kTileSize);
+            const int tileCol = static_cast<int>(index % kTileSize);
+            const std::size_t aRow =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t aCol = tileStart + tileCol;
+            const std::size_t bRow = tileStart + tileRow;
+            const std::size_t bCol =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + tileCol;
+
+            tileA[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (aRow < rows && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;
+            tileB[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int k = 0; k < kTileSize; ++k) {
+            const double b = tileB[k][tx];
+            #pragma unroll
+            for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+                accumulators[outputRow] +=
+                    tileA[ty * kRowsPerThread + outputRow][k] * b;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int outputRow = 0; outputRow < kRowsPerThread; ++outputRow) {
+        const std::size_t row = rowBase + outputRow;
+        if (row < rows && col < N) {
+            C[row * N + col] = accumulators[outputRow];
+        }
+    }
 }

+// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization.  This is kept
+// identical to the original benchmark so that -r remains reproducible.
+constexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const std::size_t N,
+                                    const std::size_t i,
+                                    const std::size_t j) noexcept {
+    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) /
+           static_cast<double>(N * N);
+}
+
+void initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                    const std::size_t N,
+                    const std::size_t firstRow,
+                    const std::size_t rowCount) {
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (std::int64_t localRow = 0;
+         localRow < static_cast<std::int64_t>(rowCount);
+         ++localRow) {
+        const std::size_t globalRow =
+            firstRow + static_cast<std::size_t>(localRow);

+            matrix[static_cast<std::size_t>(localRow) * N + column] =
+                getPseudoRndValue(N, globalRow, column);
         }
     }
